headline: PROP sector leads the market as CMC soars 30.56% and EVER jumps 22.22% on director changes and strong buying.
market_take: Today's coverage shows PROP delivering the biggest upside, highlighted by CMC (+30.56%) and EVER (+22.22%) with notable 5‑day gains of +83.3% and +50% respectively. FOOD is mixed: F&D spikes 18.75% on a price gap, while XBIO slides 12.5% after an opening gap and a SET clarification filing. Unusual volume spikes appear across CONS, PFREIT and PROP, indicating heightened trader activity.

sector_notes.note: CMC (+30.56%) and EVER (+22.22%) lead the rally, supported by recent director appointments and resignations at CMC. Other PROP names show moderate gains (MK +9.43%, MJD +6.45%) and a few declines (PF -20%).
F&D posts a strong +18.75% price gap, while XBIO drops -12.5% after an opening gap and a high‑priority SET clarification filing. AQUA records a +10% intraday rise.
STECON rises 6.86% on a volume spike; PLE falls -10% intraday, and PYLON shows an 8.7σ volume surge.
M‑PAT exhibits volatility with a -17.65% gap and a +17.86% intraday rise; IMPACT and WHART register large volume spikes (5.2σ and 10.0σ).
PPPM declines -4.76% with modest volume, reflecting sector weakness.
